brief.purpose: A local-first co-creative studio where designers and frontend builders work with AI to weave rough drafts into polished, editable, runnable interfaces
brief.concept: Create an abstract uppercase D monogram inspired by the behavior of a weaverbird, not a literal bird illustration. Three broad feather-like or woven bands represent human intent, design system, and AI; they interlock to form one unmistakable capital D, expressing fragments of drafts being woven into a coherent design. A single sharp triangular notch may suggest a weaverbird beak pulling a strand, while the central negative space may suggest a nest holding one small golden seed or egg of inspiration. Preserve a clean D outer silhouette. No eyes, feet, individual feather details, cartoon bird body, realistic nest, branches, document pages, writing lines, robots, chat bubbles, cursors, code brackets, or generic AI sparkle
brief.style: Distinctive brand-logo monogram with an intelligent animal metaphor hidden inside the geometry; creative, warm, collaborative, and precise. Flat-vector construction using three large interwoven shapes plus at most one tiny golden inspiration form, strong uppercase-D silhouette, readable at 16 px, and viable as a one-color mark. No mascot illustration, gradients, gloss, texture, thin lines, tiny decoration, shadows, enclosing app tile, or mockup
brief.palette: deep violet #6429E8, sky blue #2AB5EE, coral orange #FF6248, small golden yellow #FFC43D; no green
